play.definition: A special-teams scoring play in which the receiving team fields a kickoff, establishes possession, executes a coordinated return and blocking scheme, and advances the ball into the opponent's end zone while maintaining control.

Action_BallCarry.label: Ball Carry
Action_BallCarry.definition: Any action by an offensive player who has possession of the football and is attempting to advance it downfield, including running, scrambling after a reception, or after a fumble recovery.

Action_CatchKick.label: Catch Kick
Action_CatchKick.definition: A returner's action of receiving and securing a kicked football in the air before it contacts the ground.

Action_KickApproach.label: Kick Approach
Action_KickApproach.definition: The kicker's controlled run-up or step sequence toward the football before making contact on a kickoff, onside kick, free kick, or placekick.

Action_None.label: None
Action_None.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.
